<div className="real-category-page">

Reference caching and instance comparison.

## Available functions

<CardGroup cols={2}>
<Card title="cache.invalidate" href="./cache-invalidate">
Removes the cached Instance entry for the given Instance.
</Card>
<Card title="cache.iscached" href="./cache-iscached">
Returns whether the given Instance has a non-nil entry in the Instance cache.
</Card>
<Card title="cache.replace" href="./cache-replace">
Sets the cached Instance entry for one Instance to another Instance.
</Card>
<Card title="cloneref" href="./cloneref">
Pushes a new Instance reference for the same same underlying Instance and returns it.
</Card>
<Card title="compareinstances" href="./compareinstances">
Compares the Instance references stored in two Instance object values.
</Card>
</CardGroup>

</div>
